rationale: Normal band is [0.90, 1.10] pu. 8 of 10 samples are inside (80%), below the required 95%, so the pre-mitigation series is non-compliant. t03 (0.889) and t04 (0.895) are below 0.90; none exceed 1.10. Applying the listed additive tap changes: -0.025 gives 6 in band, 0.0 gives 8, +0.025 gives all 10 in band with min 0.914 and max 1.091 (within absolute limits [0.85, 1.10]); +0.05 pushes the maximum to 1.116, violating the absolute upper limit. The best valid correction is +0.025 pu.
